messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The MSPN registers the measurement at the GO. The GO examines the application of the MSPN. The GO rejects the application of the MSPN or the GO confirmes the application of the MSPN. The GO assigns the MSPN. The GO informs the MSPO about the assignment of MSPN. The GO informs the MPO about the assignment of the MSPN. The GO informs the SP about the assignment of MSPN.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MSPN_Assignment" name="MSPN Assignment Process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Start">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Application Rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reject</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Completed" name="Assignment Completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Final</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Register" name="Register measurement at GO">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <bpmndi:bpmndi xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI">
          <bpmndi:BPMNShape bpmnElement="Task_Register" id="BPMNShape_Task_Register">
            <omgdc:Bounds xmlns:omgdc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" x="152" y="102" width="100" height="80" />
          </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
        </bpmndi:bpmndi>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Examine" name="Examine application of MSPN">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision" name="Decision Gateway" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reject</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Confirm</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_Register" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_Register" targetRef="Task_Examine" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_Examine" targetRef="Gateway_Decision" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reject" name="Reject" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Rejected</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirm" name="Confirm" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="Task_Assign">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Confirmed</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Assign" name="Assign MSPN">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Confirm</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Parallel_Start" name="Parallel Start" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MSPO</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MPO</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SP</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Inform_MSPO" name="Inform MSPO about assignment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MSPO</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_MSPO</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Inform_MPO" name="Inform MPO about assignment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MPO</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_MPO</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Inform_SP" name="Inform SP about assignment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SP</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_SP</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Parallel_End" name="Parallel End" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_MSPO</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_MPO</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_SP</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Final</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_Assign" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_Start" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MSPO" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Start" targetRef="Task_Inform_MSPO" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPO" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Start" targetRef="Task_Inform_MPO" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SP" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_Start" targetRef="Task_Inform_SP" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_MSPO" sourceRef="Task_Inform_MSPO" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_End" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_MPO" sourceRef="Task_Inform_MPO" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_End" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_SP" sourceRef="Task_Inform_SP" targetRef="Gateway_Parallel_End" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Final" sourceRef="Gateway_Parallel_End" targetRef="EndEvent_Completed" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_1">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_GO" name="GO" processRef="Process_MSPN_Assignment" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
